title: finding(components): `page:card` is the one surviving `body` reader whose retired spelling OUTRANKS `children` — and its retirement has a ground but no carrier
body:
Path: none | 退役第四成员,其"ground"未实测 | 不升级类

Raised by the `os-dev` seat delivering objectui#6771 round 6 (PR objectui#9895) as its
`open_questions[0]`, and **re-measured in this seat before filing**, ⛔ not adopted from the report.
objectui PR head read: `059a41c65eb15679232b181c8f04d585de19ee53`.
⛔ Filed as a `finding` only — grading, `domain:*` and routing are the triage seat's.

## The shape

objectui#6771 retires the `body` child-list dialect across the renderer surface. Four reads survive in
`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, and objectui#9916 holds **three** of them:
`page:section`, `page:footer`, `page:sidebar`. It sets the fourth aside explicitly — its own body calls
`page:card` 「grounded」 and its `Restart-when:` names only the other three.

⇒ `page:card`'s read has a **ground** and ⛔ **no open carrier anywhere**. That is the gap this card fills.

## ⭐ The sharper half — `page:card` is not just a fourth container, it is the inverted one

Read at head `059a41c65` (file fetched from the API at 2026-09-18T21:14:00Z, 2313 lines):

| line | read | which spelling wins when **both** keys are present |
|--:|:--|:--|
| **960** | `const body = schema?.body ?? schema?.children;` | ⚠️ **`body`** — the retired spelling **outranks** the live one |
| 1167 | `renderChildren(schema?.children \|\| schema?.body)` | `children` |
| 2274 | `renderChildren(schema?.children \|\| schema?.body)` | `children` |
| 2301 | `renderChildren(schema?.children \|\| schema?.body)` | `children` |

Instrument: `grep -nE "schema\?\.body|\.body\b"` over the head blob, comment lines dropped. Lit control
in the same corpus and same instrument: `schema?.children` → **4**. Absent-token control
`zzqq_never_written_token_31415926` → **0**. Lines 456 and 494 (`n.body`) are generic `any` node
walkers with no registration and are ⛔ not container reads.

Two consequences the three thin containers do **not** have:

1. On a document carrying both keys, `page:card` renders the **retired** one. The other three render the
   live one, so the same document paints differently depending on which container holds it.
2. `??` and `||` disagree on falsy-but-present values. Under `??`, an authored `body: 0` or `body: ''`
   **wins** over a populated `children`; under `||` it does not. The diff carries a
   `node-slot-numeric-falsy` test, so the falsy case is live territory here, ⛔ not hypothetical.

⚠️ Neither consequence is measured against stored documents by this card — see the precondition.

## The governing text, quoted rather than characterised

`@objectstack/spec`, `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts:5320`, read 2026-09-18T21:13:45Z:

> stored documents — that is objectui's to retire on its own schedule, exactly

and again at `packages/spec/src/ui/component.test.ts:503`:

> that fallback is objectui's to retire on its own schedule.

⇒ the contract hands the retirement to objectui **and names a schedule**. objectui has ⛔ no schedule for
`page:card`. A fallback whose end condition has no owner is how a temporary read becomes permanent —
⭐ which is the exact shape objectui#6771 spent six rounds retiring across thirteen registrations.

## The precondition — ⛔ this is not executable today, and saying so is the point

The same empirical reading objectui#9916 waits on governs here: **stored rows replayed through the shipped
`page-card-body-to-children` conversion**, taken by a seat or tool that can see tenant documents, with a
control that FIRES. Nobody in this repository can take it.

`Restart-when: manual` — a reading of the STORED corpus exists for `body` on `page:card`, taken with a
firing control. ⚠️ Marked `manual` deliberately: the condition names no issue, no tracked path and no
runnable command, so a `closed #N` or predicate form would be a hold that **nothing can ever fire** —
the half-state patrol's H9 shape. objectui#9916 currently carries that defect on its own
`Restart-when:` line and is flagged for it; ⛔ this card does not repeat it.

## Dedupe, with the corpus and the controls stated

Corpus: 400 most recently created objectui issues **and PRs, open and closed**, plus every
`needs-user-decision` card in both states — 428 unique, read 2026-09-18T21:12:51Z.
`GET /search/issues` is proxy-refused from this session (HTTP 403 on all four probes **including both
controls**, so ⛔ no reading at all, not a zero), and MCP semantic search returned 0 on a query whose
answer is a known card — ⛔ a broken-instrument zero. This corpus is the channel that works.

| term | hits |
|:--|:--|
| `page:card` | 3 — objectui#9916, objectui#9895, objectui#9589 |
| `page-card-body-to-children` | **0** |
| `ADR-0087 D2` | 4 — objectui#9916, objectui#9895, objectui#9639, objectui#9621 |
| lit control `retire-vs-remove discriminator` | **6** — the instrument fires |
| absent control `zzqq_never_written_token_31415926` | **0** |

objectui#9589 is closed and scopes `page:card` into 「family C and outside this card」. objectui#9916 is open
and sets it aside by name. ⇒ ⛔ **no duplicate.**

## Why it is filed rather than folded into objectui#9916

Widening objectui#9916 would be the cheap move and it is the wrong one twice over: that card is
`pm:on-hold` behind a `Restart-when:` the patrol already reads as unfireable prose, so folding this in
inherits a broken hold; and its finding is about **three thin containers that all resolve `children`
first**, which is ⛔ not this read's shape. Repairing objectui#9916's own line is its own work and stays
with it.

## What a repair has to decide

1. Does `page:card` keep reading `body` at all, or does the shipped conversion already cover every stored
   document? ⛔ Unanswerable from this repository — that is the precondition above.
2. If the read stays, does the precedence stay inverted? ⭐ Making it `schema?.children ?? schema?.body`
   would cost nothing today and align it with the other three — but it is a **behaviour change** on any
   stored document carrying both keys, so it needs the same corpus reading, ⛔ not a drive-by fix.
3. If the read goes, it goes with the three thin ones or ahead of them — a sequencing call that belongs
   with whoever holds objectui#9916.

## Provenance

- Raised as `open_questions[0]` on `os-dev-report` `5735915218` (objectui#6771, 2026-09-18T20:40:00Z),
  whose own recommendation was option **A — file a card** — the disposition this filing takes.
- ⛔ The report's reading was **not** adopted: every table, count and quotation above was re-measured
  here, and the inverted-precedence half is ⛔ not in the report.
- Half-state patrol row H52 on objectui#6771 (sweep run 2026-09-18T21:03:56Z–21:11:14Z) names the same
  residual and prescribes exactly this remedy: a **new** card linking the ruled one, ⛔ never re-hanging
  `needs-user-decision` on objectui#6771.
